full_text:
Out in the wide, tranquil meadows where wildflowers bent gracefully before the seaside breeze, there lived The golden weathercock on the church spire looked down at the farmyard cock strutting among the hens: "What a common, noisy bird! He scratches in the dung-heap, whereas I am made o.... While the hurried world rushed past with noisy ambitions and proud words, the quiet creatures of the hearth and garden listened to the gentle music of life, noticing the delicate details that noisy vanity never perceives.

As the twilight settled and shadows lengthened across the floorboards, the deeper meaning of the journey became clear. Through the changing seasons of frost, rain, and golden summer light, the heart learned to endure every trial with gentle patience. In moments of solitude and quiet longing, the soul whispered its sincere hopes to the stars, discovering that true worth does not depend on outward glitter or the praise of the crowd.

At last, when the trial reached its appointed close, the light of genuine virtue shone with irresistible radiance. When the moment of transformation arrived, truth dissolved the illusions of pride and vanity.  The cold winds melted away into a dawn of peace, leaving behind a fragrant memory that touched every heart with wonder, proving that living vitality and purpose surpass high-perched, hollow vanity that turns with every breeze.
moral: Living vitality and purpose surpass high-perched, hollow vanity that turns with every breeze.
